arabic text: JIBREEL NAWHA PARTE HAI, MARE GAYE ALI\nMAULA-E-KAYINAAT PE TALWAAR CHALGAYI
english translation text: Jibraeel recites the lament: ‘Ali has been struck down.’\nThe sword has fallen upon the Master of the universe.

arabic text: MASJID UDAAS MIMBARE, KUFA UDAAS HAI\nTAR KHOON ME KHUDA KE WALI, KA LIBAAS HAI\nROTA HAI ASMAAN ZAMI(N) GHAMSE PHAT GAYI
english translation text: The mosque is desolate, the pulpit and Kufa are desolate;\nthe clothing of God’s wali is drenched in blood.\nThe heavens weep, and the earth has split from grief.

arabic text: MASJID ME ROZADAR PAR, KAYSA SITAM HUWA\nKAABE SE AA RAHI HAI SADAA, WA MUSIBATA\nGHAMSE NABI KI KABR BHI, AB KAAMPNE LAGI
english translation text: What oppression befell the fasting one in the mosque!\nA cry of ‘Wa musibata’ rises from the Kaaba;\neven the Prophet’s grave now begins to tremble with grief.

arabic text: HAI HAI YATEEM SHABBAR-O-SHABBIR HOGAYE\nABBAS DILKO THAAMKE ROTE HUWE CHALE\nSARSE RIDAAYE ZAINAB-O-KULSUM GIRGAYI
english translation text: Alas, Shabbar and Shabbir have been orphaned;\nAbbas walks on, clutching his heart and weeping.\nThe veils of Zainab and Kulsum fall from their heads.

arabic text: DUNIYA MEI BEKASO KA SAHARA NAHI RAHA\nUTRAA THA JO FALAK SE SITARA NAHI RAHA\nARSHE BAREEN PE FARSHE AZAA AAJ BICHGAYI
english translation text: The helpless no longer have a supporter in this world;\nthe star that descended from the heavens is no more.\nUpon the highest Throne, the floor of mourning has been spread today.

arabic text: MAULA MERA JO KHOON ME APNE NAHA GAYA\nBOLE FARISHTE HAYE YE, KAISA SITAM HUWA\nHURRAIN YE ROKE KEHTI THI, DUNIYA UJARGAYI
english translation text: My Master was bathed in his own blood;\nthe angels cried, ‘What terrible oppression is this!’\nHurra-in wept and said, ‘The world has been ruined.’

arabic text: ZAHRA LAHAD ME ROTI HAI, HAYDAR KE WASTE\nKEHTI HAI CHEYN KABR KE ANDAR NAHI MUJE\nBACHO PE MERE GHAM KI GHATA AAJ CHHAGAYI
english translation text: Zahra weeps in the grave for Haider;\nshe says, ‘I find no peace within the grave.\nA cloud of grief has descended upon my children today.’
